info.title: Gym Management API
info.description: REST API for managing a gym: plans, members, trainers, sessions, bookings, memberships and payments, QR check-in, analytics and Excel/CSV exports, plus member and trainer portals. Errors use RFC 9457 Problem Details with a machine-readable "code".
